disposition_reason: The original GLM has an ordered cross-validated likelihood objective, but its comparable numeric performance baseline and cohort-level reduction were not recovered. The reported modulation indices and fractions of significantly decodable cells describe biology and cannot become quantities to maximize. The local ridge/eye-covariate, blocked-fold conditional gap-direction score changes the source comparison.

source_paper.title: Encoding of cerebellar dentate neuron activity during visual attention in rhesus macaques

evidence.locator: Results: Encoding of task events, Decoding trial variables; Figures 3–4; Methods: Encoding model and Decoding model
evidence.supports: Identifies the dentate encoding/decoding analyses, source likelihood-based model selection, and descriptive reported outputs.

evidence.locator: fitSingleCellGLM, baselineTrials default and design construction around lines 139–159
evidence.supports: Defines six event kernels and a response-derived five-trial moving-average baseline before cross-validation.

evidence.locator: fit method, cvTrainSel generation, cv1NegLnL selection and cv2NegLnL evaluation around lines 496–529
evidence.supports: Separate trial-based cross-validation assignments select regularization and evaluate goodness of fit; retained fitInfo is a possible author-baseline recovery route, not an observed score.

evidence.locator: January 22, 2025 release; README Files and variables
evidence.supports: cells4.2.mat.zip supplies per-cell trials, monkey/cell identities, spike seconds, event milliseconds and eye traces; archive also contains some Purkinje cells.

evidence.locator: Prospective paired models and evaluation; evaluator.py evaluate_cell/evaluate
evidence.supports: The retained implementation uses a new conditional full-minus-reduced likelihood in nats/spike, ridge harmonics, eye inputs and guarded contiguous folds; it is not source GLM parity.

target.description: Predict individual dentate-neuron spike counts from trial events and category-dependent event responses; retain the original encoding problem. Behavioral decoding and modulation summaries are distinct source analyses, not interchangeable scalar victory targets.

dataset.description: Dryad DOI 10.5061/dryad.1rn8pk14s, January 22, 2025 cells4.2.mat.zip release. Only metadata was reviewed; no neural payload was opened.

cohort.description: Paper records 305 DN neurons from macaques Mi and Mo. Exact analysis-included cells/trials must be reconciled to the archive, whose README also notes Purkinje-cell records; all eligible source DN cells must be retained.

split.description: Paper specifies fivefold likelihood selection; CategorizedModel creates separate trial-based CV assignments for regularization and goodness-of-fit. Original fold realizations/random state and the compared model-stage outputs remain unrecovered; contiguous guarded folds are an extension.

inputs.description: Original encoding uses fixation, C onset, delay, choice-target, saccade and reward timing with current/past trial categories. The author baseline also uses response-derived trial-rate smoothing, which must be disclosed; adding eye regressors or a training-only null changes the comparison.

preprocessing.description: Methods describe 25-ms counts and five event-basis functions over 1.5 seconds; code uses a five-trial rate baseline. Converter settings, exclusions and exact original count support need source-run reconciliation, including the registered 25-ms paper versus 50-ms converter-default mismatch.

metric.description: Recover the original evaluated predictive likelihood and its normalization from cv2NegLnL. No published scalar on that exact support was recovered. Figure 3 modulation strength and Figure 4 significant-cell fraction are not predictive-accuracy objectives.

aggregation.description: Original figures summarize cell properties separately by monkey; no source-defined single cross-cell predictive-likelihood aggregation was recovered. A pooled nats/spike or cell-macro average must not silently become the published score.

comparison.primary_metric: Original held-out Poisson predictive likelihood; exact source reduction unresolved

published_baseline.description: No numeric source predictive-likelihood baseline was recovered; biological modulation indices and significant-cell percentages are not substitutes.

reproduced_author_baseline.description: Pinned fitSingleCellGLM/CategorizedModel provide a recovery route for original model predictions and cv2NegLnL, but no authentic author run or matched score exists in this audit.

minimum_effect.rationale: A task-specific useful likelihood gain needs original likelihood normalization, baseline variability and source support; no generic nats/spike margin is adopted.

uncertainty.method: Predeclare paired uncertainty after original folds and aggregate are recovered; retain dependence among cells/trials from the same animal.
uncertainty.independent_unit: Two macaques, with cells and trials nested within animal.
uncertainty.rationale: Treating 305 cells or repeated folds as independent animals would overstate replication.

paper_win_requires: Recover a quantitative author performance baseline on the exact source DN cohort, trial exclusions, information conditions and CV outputs.
Calibrate the author implementation before testing a candidate; reproducing modulation figures is only calibration.
Compare candidate and author predictions on identical source folds and metric support, with a justified effect and dependence-aware uncertainty rule fixed before final scoring.
Do not count stronger p-values, more modulated cells, retrospective-versus-online changes, added inputs or the prospective blocked-fold conditional endpoint as surpassing the source paper.

current_sota.description: No current-SOTA comparison was reviewed or claimed; source-paper and author-rerun comparisons are separate.

episode.improvement_loop: Inactive until the original predictive score is recovered. Then use only declared training/selection feedback for method iteration while preserving the original information condition.
episode.candidate_freeze: Freeze model, source task mapping, preprocessing, original fold manifest, metric reduction and acceptance rule before final comparisons.
episode.final_evaluation: Evaluate candidate and source-author baseline on the same original support once; any redesigned blocked split remains a separately labeled extension.
episode.baseline_policy: Neither the local full-minus-reduced ridge model nor its null is the source-author baseline. Published score, recovered author score and future SOTA score remain separate.

blocking_issues: Original numeric predictive likelihood, normalization and across-cell aggregation have not been recovered.
Exact original folds, complete eligible DN cohort and source converter settings remain unbound.
Response-derived moving-average inputs and the published versus converter bin-width difference require explicit same-task reconciliation.
Native MATLAB/SPAMS source baseline, working matched evaluator, meaningful effect, valid uncertainty, and concrete access/resource budgets are not qualified.

legacy.notes: Preserve all dentate reconstruction and prospective conditional-gap code. Its guarded block validation, eye covariates, ridge hierarchy and nats/spike contrast define an extension, not an original-paper success criterion.
